ios.desc:
Take control of your virtual game finances with Toy Wallet, the ultimate app designed to track your in-game money in popular board games like Monopoly. Elevate your gaming experience and ensure your digital cash is always in order with this essential companion app.

KEY FEATURES

- Manage Multiple Games: Effortlessly handle multiple game sessions, allowing you to pause and resume at your convenience. Toy Wallet gives you the flexibility to switch between games seamlessly while keeping track of your progress.

- Create Unlimited Accounts: Create as many accounts as you need for each game, providing dedicated spaces for every player to manage their virtual wealth. Stay organized and keep the competition fierce with personalized accounts.

- Secure Account Protection: Safeguard your accounts with ease. Toy Wallet offers multiple security options, including a 4-digit PIN and the convenience of NFC-Cards, ensuring your game money remains safe and confidential.

- NFC-Cards Compatibility: Enjoy the convenience of NFC technology. Toy Wallet supports all NDEF-formatted NFC cards and tokens, including popular options like NTAG215. Simply tap your cards to access and update your account balances effortlessly.

- Customize Account Colors: Personalize your virtual accounts with a wide range of color choices. Showcase your style and easily differentiate your account from others, creating an engaging and visually appealing experience.

- Multi-Currency Support: Choose from a variety of currencies to match your gaming preferences. Whether you prefer classic Monopoly dollars or want to explore different virtual currencies, Toy Wallet has you covered.

- Enhance Your Game: Elevate your gaming sessions with Toy Wallet's comprehensive features designed to enhance your virtual banking simulation. From managing digital cash to credit cards, Toy Wallet provides all the tools you need to excel.

Download Toy Wallet now and become the master of your virtual finances! Say goodbye to misplaced paper money and the hassle of tracking credit — our intuitive app puts the power of virtual banking in your hands. Experience the future of game finance tracking and bring a new level of excitement to your gaming sessions with Toy Wallet. Play, track, and dominate!

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

Yesterday I finally released my first App on the AppStore :)

It all began when we played Monopoly with a few friends and started running out of paper money quite often. I always loved the idea of the banking version of Monopoly (with the chip cards) so I decided to develop something similar as an app.

You can create multiple accounts (everyone can pick his favourite colour), and then transfer money to each other or to/from the bank.

To prevent cheaters you can also either set a PIN for each account that has to be entered whenever money is being taken out or (if your device supports it) use a NFC (NTAG) card or token as authorization method.

We really love using the app in our family especially when playing it with NFC cards as it gives a real banking feeling :)

You can also start multiple games and pick up a game later if you need to interrupt playing.

I translated the app in as many languages possible but I guess there might be a lot of translation mistakes :)

I'm really looking forward to get some feedback from you folks on the app, what do you think I could improve? And please feel free to share any translaton mistake you have found.

- Max
